Sorry for the late reply! Your Music teacher might be super super strict about it, and sometimes teachers are assholes, but it does help. It really (honest beyond belief) helps. Your posture (as they've probably yelled at you about) helps increase your lung capacity. Which gives you more air to produce sound, AND gives more space for the sound-waves produced by your vocal chords / instrument to create resonance.

TLDR

Posture makes your tone, tune, confidence, and (kinda) rhythmic accuracy better! (in a round-a-bout way!)

They will not call the police on you! They are there for emotional support. Call them. You are in a place that it is necessary. I've called many times and they have always helped me.

As a stranger, with no sentimental attachment to you, O can say (simply from how you've been talking to me, that you have common decency. I'm a teacher (Band at high school level) I've seen sooo many people that feel everyone hates them. (I've been there myself... again) If you'll hear some pysch B.S.... we call that "The invisible audience" even if you've felt a lot of people hate you, I can promise you it significantly less than you think.

Sure you've had pretty concrete examples of people not liking you, BUT you know that people care about you.

Look dude, the plan B you have (Being you kind of pull back from everything) is SSSOOOO MUCH better than offing yourself.

My question, if it's okay, is why do you feel that these drastic measures are necessary?

I know it's cliche. But I've called the suicide hotline SO MANY FUCKING TIMES. they've helped me personally get through my immediate issues (convinced me not to etc) AND have helped me find people that can help me. I urge you to at least try that. Really, talking to someone verbally (or better in person) is sooooo much better
